calculation.expression: shift_1((-log(close/close.shift(3)) / rolling_std(log(close/close.shift(1)),20)) * I[dispersion > rolling_252_quantile(dispersion,0.65) AND breadth < rolling_60_quantile(breadth,0.35)])
calculation.description: Within elevated cross-asset dispersion and weak market breadth, rank assets by their recent three-session losses normalized by 20-session volatility; the lagged signal is designed to capture panic overshoot reversal. Inactive dates have missing values rather than fabricated scores.

decay.note: Validated at the 10-trading-day horizon; candidate was not admitted on an untested horizon.

validation.regime_notes: Negative in the sparse 2020 stress subset, positive and strong in 2023-2030, and negative in the short 2031 subset. Full-sample IC and ICIR barely clear the benchmark gates; uncertainty is high because only 219 activated dates are available.
